source: Horton JC, Hoyt WF (1991). The representation of the visual field in human striate cortex: a revision of the classic Holmes map. Archives of Ophthalmology 109(6):816-824.
quantity: linear cortical magnification factor M(E), mm of striate cortex per degree of visual angle, along a meridian
eccentricity_E_units: degrees of visual angle from the fovea
basis: Revision of Holmes' (1918, 1945) map from magnetic-resonance-localised occipital lesions with quantitative visual-field defects in humans; the formula summarises the paper's revised map.
comparison_note: Bressloff et al. (2001) Section 2 use the same functional form, M(r) = alpha/(w0 + eps r) = (alpha/eps)/(w0/eps + r); the script compares the two over 1-40 degrees and reports the RMS relative error and the implied constants A = alpha/eps, E2 = w0/eps.
